_comment: Read by scripts/check_lane.py (CI), which runs the copy on the base branch so a PR can't loosen its own check. Paths are matched lowercased (PaymentForm.tsx counts as a payment file), so write patterns in lowercase; * also matches /. A changed file that matches one_way_paths, and not not_one_way, makes the PR a Bet whatever it says. Edit for this project's real folders; changing this file is itself a Bet.
_not_one_way: */author[!i]* keeps author pages out of *auth* (authorize and authority stay in). Shortcut: it also exempts a file like auth/author-roles.ts; narrow it if this project has one.
